description: The chart is a grouped bar chart illustrating F1 Score performance (in percent) across multiple datasets for MADLLM and three ablated variants. The category axis is the horizontal axis labeled “Dataset,” with six dataset names shown in order from left to right: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The value axis is the vertical axis labeled “F1 Score (%),” shown on a linear scale spanning approximately 60 to 100 with tick marks at 60, 70, 80, 90, and 100. Each dataset has four adjacent bars corresponding to the legend: MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange). For SMD, all four bars are in the mid-to-high 90s (green and purple around ~95, blue around ~96, orange around ~97). For PSM, green and purple are near ~99, blue is around the mid-80s (~85), and orange is near ~99. For SWaT, green and purple are near ~98–99, blue is around ~96, and orange is around ~97. For SMAP, green is near ~99, purple is around the high-80s (~88–89), blue is around ~89–90, and orange is around the high-80s (~87–88). For MSL, green and purple are near ~99, blue is around ~94–95, and orange is near ~99. For WADI, green is around ~97, purple is around ~92, blue is around ~94, and orange is around ~96. The bars are grouped by dataset rather than sorted by value, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the distinct colors and the legend.
